(B) The oranges are the second-most expensive
(C) The pears are the second-most expensive

- The oranges are the second-most expensive, which means they are cheaper than the pears but more expensive than the watermelons.
- The pears are more expensive than the watermelons, so the pears cannot be the second-most expensive.

- The oranges are cheaper than the pears.
- The pears are cheaper than the watermelons.

(A) The watermelons are the second-most expensive - This contradicts the information that the pears are more expensive than the watermelons.
